tracks.title: Minuet, BWV Anh. 114 · excerpt
tracks.credit: Christian Petzold. Performed by KasraR (2013), released by its creator under the worldwide PD-self dedication. A 22.2-second excerpt, not the complete 98-second performance.
tracks.changes: Audio extracted from a credited public mirror, silent end card removed; 70 ms fade-in / 350 ms fade-out; MP3 conversion. Excerpt repeated at adjusted playback volume.

tracks.title: Goldberg Variations · Aria, BWV 988
tracks.credit: Open Goldberg Variations. Piano performance by Kimiko Ishizaka, 2012. Recording released under CC0. The downloaded source OGG hash matches the Commons original.
tracks.changes: OGG converted to MP3 at 160 kbps; no cuts, tempo or pitch changes. Repeated playback and volume adjustment.

tracks.title: C major Prelude, WTC Book I · BWV 846
tracks.credit: Kimiko Ishizaka, The Well-Tempered Clavier Book 1 (2015). Prelude only. The performer released this recording under CC0.
tracks.changes: Pinned public MP3 mirror; mirror removed artwork/lyrics/comments while retaining the audio stream. App copy has no further edits. Repeated playback and volume adjustment.

tracks.title: French Suite No. 2 · Allemande, BWV 813
tracks.credit: MIDI performance © John Sankey. Digital piano rendering of the Allemande from French Suite No. 2, BWV 813. Copyright and permission notice accompany the source MIDI.
tracks.changes: Movement selected from the attributed MIDI performance and rendered with GeneralUser GS piano. Digital performance, repeated playback and volume adjustment.

tracks.title: Siciliano · Largo e spiccato, BWV 596
tracks.composer: Antonio Vivaldi · arr. J. S. Bach
tracks.credit: Organ transcription by J. S. Bach after Vivaldi, RV 565 / Op. 3 No. 11. Recorded by Metzner on 24 July 2009. CC BY 3.0. The slow Siciliano / Largo movement only.
tracks.changes: Unedited remote Commons recording. Repeated playback and volume adjustment. Requires an internet connection and a supported audio codec.

tracks.title: Air (Air on the G String) · BWV 1068
tracks.performer: USAF Band, Air Force Strings · Keith H. Bland (2000)
tracks.credit: Air from Orchestral Suite No. 3, BWV 1068. Air Force Strings, conducted by 1st Lt. Keith H. Bland, Collage (2000). Commons identifies the performance and recording as official-duty U.S. Air Force work. Popularly known as Air on the G String; this is a strings performance.
tracks.changes: AAC transcode obtained from a pinned public mirror with Commons provenance; app copy unchanged. Repeated playback and volume adjustment.

tracks.title: Solo Violin Sonata No. 2 · Andante, BWV 1003
tracks.performer: Score-based digital violin · FluidSynth / GeneralUser GS
tracks.credit: MIDI/engraving by Hajo Dezelski, Mutopia-2008/07/13-1456, based on Bach-Gesellschaft Edition 1879 Band 27.1. CC BY-SA 3.0. Digital sampled violin rendering; no human violinist is claimed. Source MIDI, rendering settings and SoundFont license accompany the audio.
tracks.changes: Encoded notes and relative rhythm preserved; rendered at 42 BPM, one pass without unfolded repeats, light reverb and edge fades; MP3 160 kbps. Repeated playback and volume adjustment.
